title: Enchiridion Changelog Metadata
description: Schema for metadata.json files in each changelog entry directory

id.description: Version identifier (e.g., '0.3', '0.3.1'). Used as the route slug.

title.description: Short title for the entry, rendered as a subtitle under the version number

summary.description: One-line summary shown in the sidebar listing

filename.description: Filename of the entry's markdown body (e.g., 'entry.md')
